column_description: A unique VARCHAR(30) record ID for external references (e.g., 'Record-90876').
A TIMESTAMP capturing the transaction creation or logging time (e.g., '2025-03-01 12:00:00').
An enum (PayMethod_enum) naming the payment type (Crypto_A, Crypto_B, Crypto_C, Token).
A NUMERIC(14,2) capturing the transaction’s total payment amount in USD (e.g., 10000.00).
A NUMERIC(10,2) for fees in USD (e.g., 15.50).
An enum (EscrowUsed_enum) indicating if escrow was used (Yes, No).
A SMALLINT for how many hours funds remain in escrow (e.g., 72).
An enum (MultiSigFlag_enum) capturing whether multi-signature was enabled (Yes, No).
An enum (TxStatus_enum) showing transaction status (Pending, Cancelled, Completed, Disputed).
A NUMERIC(5,2) measuring how many hours until completion (e.g., 48.75).
An enum (ShipMethod_enum) describing delivery approach (Express, Standard, Custom, Digital).
An enum (ShipRegionSrc_enum) for the source region (Region_A, Region_B, Region_C, Unknown).
An enum (ShipRegionDst_enum) for the destination region (Region_X, Region_Y, Region_Z, Unknown).
An enum (CrossBorderFlag_enum) stating if it's an international transaction (Yes, No).
An enum (RouteComplexity_enum) describing shipping route complexity (Complex, Medium, Simple).
FK referencing Markets(MktRegistry). Identifies which market the transaction occurred on.
FK referencing Products(ProdRegistry). Ties transaction to a product listing.
FK referencing Buyers(BuyRegistry). Specifies the buyer who initiated the transaction.
